subject.title: [Feature]: Standardize skill data directory convention (configPaths) under ~/.openclaw/

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class per-skill writable data contract, and if so should it be a skill metadata filesystem convention, runtime/plugin state API, or ClawHub authoring rule?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding new durable skill metadata or storage behavior creates a public authoring and upgrade contract that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Design core skill-data contract
options.body: Add a narrow metadata/runtime contract with install, docs, tests, and storage or doctor rules before implementation.

options.title: Use ClawHub guidance only
options.body: Document a recommended OpenClaw-state-root subdirectory for skill authors without runtime creation or placeholder support.

options.title: Defer core support
options.body: Leave current behavior unchanged until stronger user evidence or a concrete plugin API gap is prioritized.

recommendation.title: Design core skill-data contract
recommendation.body: Add a narrow metadata/runtime contract with install, docs, tests, and storage or doctor rules before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly tied to recent skill runtime documentation and broad product-surface decisions among the likely owners identified here.
